description: Claude Code session log inspection ops — list, tail, summarize .jsonl transcripts under ~/.claude/projects/.

claude-log-list.description: List N recent Claude sessions for project (def 10). UUID, mtime, line count, first user msg. The store is resolved UPWARD ONLY and in three states (#1317): this cwd's own, else the nearest ancestor's — named in the header as a substitution, because an ancestor is not the directory you asked about — else a decline naming the path it looked for and how many stores exist. A SIBLING is never used: a prefix-match fallback rendered another worktree's sessions as the caller's. Values matching known secret patterns are redacted and the redaction disclosed; append :raw for verbatim

claude-log-tail.description: Last N events of session in compact form. Def N=30. Use after claude-log-list. Values matching known secret patterns are redacted and the redaction disclosed; append :raw for verbatim

claude-log-cost.description: What tool results cost, in bytes: per tool and per supertool op (split on the render's own '--- op ---' markers), size distribution, repeat reads with the share of bytes they re-paid, errors and empties. Sessions that could not be parsed are listed as skipped with a reason, never dropped from the total. Def: 10 most recent sessions of this project; pass a UUID for one. With no UUID the store is resolved the same three ways claude-log-list resolves it (#1317) — this cwd, an ancestor named as a substitution, or a decline; never a sibling

claude-log-summary.description: Session digest: tool counts, errors, final msg, total turns. Values matching known secret patterns are redacted and the redaction disclosed; append :raw for verbatim
